dedupe_keys.name: comparison of wind turbine load surrogate model performances with multi scale local inflow parameterization

description: Ramaswamy, Harihara Rajan and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The evaluated models compare rotor averages, sector averages, proper orthogonal decomposition and convolutional representations of resolved inflow fields. A dynamic aeroelastic simulation database supports validation across wakes and farm layouts. The wind-farm-loads Python package couples surrogate estimates with quasi-static farm simulations. The source finds that inconsistent wake-added turbulence can bias loads. This model study has a distinct inflow-representation object; shared TWAIN training provenance does not establish wholly independent validation datasets. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The surrogates provide load estimates to related wind-farm design calculations.
